notes: PANEL CORPUS WITH A PLANTED DRIFT. Each athlete_id carries a series of records at different time_to_competition_days. The within-athlete temporal structure was PLANTED by src/ingestion/temporal.py under an owner decision of 2026-09-29: somatic anxiety rises approaching the event while cognitive anxiety and self-confidence stay flat, per CSAI-2 multidimensional anxiety theory [Martens1990; Cox2003]. Any trajectory recovered from this corpus is a sanity check on this project's own instrumentation, NOT evidence about athletes and NOT support for the psychological claim itself. athlete_id and timepoint_index live in record.extra. Template selection is UNBIASED with respect to src.evaluation.baselines.CONSTRUCT_CUES: no realisation is chosen because the lexicon can detect it, so this corpus does not inflate the lexicon baseline (OPEN-021). synth_precomp_v1 is untouched by this corpus.
